{{Quote|I could never truly be friends with anyone who grew up in the Zaltin corporate culture. My people are with Xucphra, the true leader in bacta production and refinement. My uncle was the person who discovered the contamination the Ashern introduced into Lot ZX1449F.|Erisi Dlarit|<ref name="rogue" />}}
The '''Dlarit family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. The Dlarit family were prominent members of the [[Xucphra Corporation]], one of the two conglomerates which, along with their rival [[Zaltin Corporation]], produced ninety-five percent of the [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="rogue" />

A notable member of this family was [[Erisi Dlarit]], a former member of the famed [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Erisi and her father, [[Aerin Dlarit]], supported former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] in her takeover of Thyferra and joined the [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]].<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> Another member was Erisi's [[Erisi Dlarit's uncle|uncle]], Aerin's brother, who discovered a contamination the [[Ashern]] rebels introduced into [[Lot ZX1449F]].<ref name="rogue" />
